title: Version 2 Bounded Beta Package

proposedScope.name: Daynori Version 2 Bounded Personal Beta Candidate
proposedScope.description: Focused offline-first personal workspace beta covering core organization, local capture, responsive PWA, and local guided learning, while strictly fencing high-risk modules pending dedicated release gates.

gatedFeatures.reason: Live Google Drive OAuth verification pending
Multi-user rooms and staffed UGC moderation pending
Commercial Play billing and subscriptions pending
Live model provider authorization and spending pending
Physical Android ARM64 TalkBack testing pending

targetPersonas: General personal organizers and note takers
Keyboard-only navigation and accessibility power users
Low-vision users with 200% font scaling and high contrast preferences

humanGateFulfillment.target: At least 5 representative consenting participants must complete the fresh-user session protocol with >= 4 capturing/reopening an item and finding Help unassisted

platforms.requirements: Modern evergreen browsers (Chromium, Firefox, Safari); responsive 320px–1440px
Offline service worker caching, IndexedDB persistence, manifest installability
Internal Play Console testing track only; unsigned/stale android/ debug fallback rejected
Phase 61-62 configuration ready; Mac build and TestFlight evidence pending

syntheticDataInstructions.privacyRule: Zero real personal secrets, real passwords, real journal entries, or sensitive financial data.
syntheticDataInstructions.fixtures: Participants use synthetic descriptions (e.g., 'Project Zebra draft', 'Morning 15m stretch', 'Team sync outline').
syntheticDataInstructions.isolation: Each tester receives an isolated personal tenant workspace; no multi-tenant cross-visibility.

consentAndFeedbackProcess.consent: Explicit digital consent prompt explaining offline-first architecture, synthetic data rule, and voluntary participation.
consentAndFeedbackProcess.feedbackChannel: In-app feedback form (POST /v1/workspaces/:workspaceId/feedback/reports) with category, severity, and optional diagnostics.
consentAndFeedbackProcess.triage: Operator feedback queue (/v1/operator/feedback/reports) authenticated via Platform Operator role.
consentAndFeedbackProcess.erasure: Self-service account deletion and JSON export available at all times.

stopCriteria: Any cross-tenant IDOR vulnerability or data leak detected.
Any data loss incident (unrecoverable draft or item corruption).
Unauthenticated or unauthorized access to operator triage endpoints.
Application unhandled crash rate exceeding 1.0% of active sessions.

knownDefects.title: Real-provider authentication journeys not freshly verified
Hosted core preview disables files, audio, and reminder delivery
Cold offline reopen serves public offline page, not private organizer
Production vault unlock blocked pending independent review
Live Google Drive connection not verified
Rooms and chat production-gated and unstaffed for real users
Live AI assistant unavailable; local provisional only
Support contact and durable feedback delivery not configured
Developer/harness surfaces reachable from ordinary Settings
Physical Android and TalkBack evidence still missing
Beginner tutorial is not action-verified full feature coverage
Live consenting human participant usability evaluation pending

gateA_localFoundation.evidence: Strict toolchain, reproducible installs, migrations, package boundaries, and local JWT verifier pass.

gateB_privatePersonalBeta.evidence: Bounded scope manifest authored, 8 candidate rehearsals pass, human participant sessions pending DEF-V2-013.

gateC_publicWebAndPlayReadiness.evidence: Physical Android hardware testing (DEF-V2-011), signed AAB, and operator publication approval unmet.

gateD_paidProduct.evidence: Billing disabled (DEF-V2-007); free core organizer scope preserved.
